body:
Run record for the re-run #23950 asks for, after its six stale clauses were re-pointed. Runner: an `os-dev` subagent dispatched by the `domain:devx` seat 2 PM (session `session_016PVjjuVPte5XEJvaQx1E4t`). Protocol: `.claude/skills/checklist-test/SKILL.md` + `docs/qa/platform-checklist/RUNNER.md`. Executed sequentially (no subagent tool in this runner).

## Environment fingerprint

- framework: `fb82f9b180bcc6af04ce8d36153fd52d2eb6845c`, the tip of branch `claude/issue-23950-checklist-stale-clauses` at run time. Its product tree is `origin/main` `022c6e799`; the branch adds `docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/*.json` only. Built with `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile && pnpm build` (75/75 tasks green).
- `.objectui-sha`: `daeb77fc84dd824e74c95b87cdede85afdb248e7` (API-only item).
- boot: `OS_PORT=47312 objectstack dev --ui --seed-admin -p 47312 -d file:(run dir)/appr/data.db` from `examples/app-showcase`.
- identities: the dev admin, who owns the organization; Ada Auditor (`usr_showcase_auditor_demo`) and Mei Phone (`usr_showcase_phone_demo`) from the seeded demo personas.
- directory rows, written through the doors the revised fixtures name: `POST /api/v1/auth/admin/set-user-manager` (admin to Mei) 200; `POST /api/v1/auth/organization/create-team` 200, then `add-team-member` for Mei and Ada, 200 each (sys_team_member reads back both); `POST /api/v1/data/sys_business_unit_member` for Mei in `bu_field_ops` and Ada in its descendant `bu_west_coast`, 201 each. The controls for the doors the fixtures retired: data-API `PATCH sys_user.manager_id` answers 403 (`manager_id` not editable via the data API, ADR-0092), and data-API `POST sys_team` answers 405 OBJECT_API_METHOD_NOT_ALLOWED.
- flows: one scratch active autolaunched flow per leg, `qa_appr_LEG`, triggered by a `showcase_field_zoo` create whose name starts `qa_LEG_`. Requests are matched by record id AND `process_name` `flow:qa_appr_LEG`.
- timestamps: 2026-10-16, 16:34Z to 16:39Z.

## Scope

Selector `approvals.approver-resolution-matrix` resolves to 1 runnable item: `approvals.approver-resolution-matrix` at revision 3, P1, surface api. The item text was read at branch head `c4bf2ba4e`. No pin is declared. The supporting suite `pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-approvals exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/admin-rescue-named-slate.integration.test.ts` passed 11 of 11.

Who the organization's administrators are: of the organization's three `sys_member` rows (admin `owner`, Ada `member`, Mei `member`), only the admin's resolved permission sets hold an organization-admin grant (`organization_admin_no_bypass`, read via `GET /api/v1/security/explain?userId=…`). So the administrators' slate is exactly the admin.

## Per-clause verdicts

| item | # | clause (short) | verdict | evidence |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| approvals.approver-resolution-matrix | 0 | each type resolves the slate it declares | pass | `pending_approvers`: user Ada → [Ada]; field `f_users` = [Ada, Mei] → [Ada, Mei]; manager → [Mei], the submitter's manager; team → [Ada, Mei]; department `bu_field_ops` → [Ada, Mei]; org_membership_level owner → [admin]; position `manager` → [admin], the position's only holder; expression `current.created_by` → [admin]. Every request is pending |
| approvals.approver-resolution-matrix | 1 | department = unit + every active descendant | pass | parent `bu_field_ops` slate [Ada, Mei], where Ada is a member only of the descendant `bu_west_coast`; after `PATCH sys_business_unit/bu_west_coast {active: false}` a re-trigger opens on [Mei]; the unit was re-activated afterwards |
| approvals.approver-resolution-matrix | 2 | multi-value field fans out per id | pass | two entries `[usr_showcase_auditor_demo, usr_showcase_phone_demo]`, never one comma-joined literal; `__resolvedFrom` `{"field:f_users": [both ids]}` |
| approvals.approver-resolution-matrix | 3 | deprecated role warns and resolves like org_membership_level | pass | `WARN [approvals] approver type 'role' is deprecated (ADR-0090 D3) — author 'org_membership_level' instead`; role owner slate [admin] = org_membership_level owner slate [admin] on the same org |
| approvals.approver-resolution-matrix | 4 | empty-slate fork per policy; admin_rescue opens on the administrators | pass | admin_rescue (key absent, and declared): pending, `pending_approvers` [admin], with no `position:qa_nobody` entry; `__resolvedFrom` `{"admin_rescue:abandoned": ["position:qa_nobody"], "admin_rescue:reason": "position 'qa_nobody' has no holder"}`; the actions carry one comment with null actor, `Routed to this organization's administrators because the approver slate named no one: position 'qa_nobody' has no holder.`; WARN `… resolved to no concrete approver (position 'qa_nobody' has no holder) — opening on this organization's administrators per onEmptyApprovers: 'admin_rescue'. …`. fail: no request from the flow, run `failed`, `NO_APPROVERS: approval node 'review' … its onEmptyApprovers policy is 'fail'`. auto_approve: no request from the flow, run `completed` down the approve edge (an `update_record` there wrote `approve edge: decision=approve autoApproved=true`, read back from `review.decision` / `review.autoApproved`), WARN `… auto-approving per onEmptyApprovers: 'auto_approve' (no request opened)`. fallback to Mei: pending [Mei], no literal slot, WARN `… opening on the declared fallbackApprovers per onEmptyApprovers: 'fallback'`. fallback to nobody: WARN `… AND its declared fallbackApprovers resolved to nobody either — falling back to admin_rescue`, request on [admin] with reason `…; the declared fallbackApprovers resolved to no one either` |
| approvals.approver-resolution-matrix | 5 | queue: dead slot, loud, never a fake approval | pass | WARN `[approvals] approver type 'queue' is not implemented — the slot resolves to nobody, …`; request pending, `pending_approvers` [admin] with no `queue:support` entry; `__resolvedFrom` `{"admin_rescue:abandoned": ["queue:support"], "admin_rescue:reason": "queue 'support' resolved to no one"}`; the routed-to-administrators comment is on its actions |

Each graph expansion to nobody (`position:qa_nobody`, `position:qa_nobody2`) carried the `… expanded to nobody — the slot names no one …` warn that names its type and value.

## Derived item verdict

`approvals.approver-resolution-matrix` r3: **pass** (6 of 6 clauses).

Fixture note: the stock showcase flow `showcase_approver_bindings` is `status: 'draft'` and triggers on `showcase_field_zoo` record-after-update. Draft flows still fire their triggers (the automation plugin says so at boot), so the auto_approve leg's approve-edge `update_record` fired it. It opened its own admin_rescue request (`flow:showcase_approver_bindings`, node `by_user`) on the same record. Matching requests by `process_name` keeps it out of every verdict above. The flow's docblock says `draft` keeps it out of the runtime. That defect is handed to the dispatching seat for its own card.

Timing: about 5 minutes of legs, on the build shared across this re-run's five records.

Checklist-accuracy findings, if any, close out on the wave anchor #23878.
